title: Conditionals and consequences
function: Talk about conditions and hypothetical results

phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn the zero, first and second conditionals to talk about real and hypothetical situations.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. If you heat water, it boils. If it rains, I will stay at home. If I had more money, I would travel. Notice: zero = general truth, first = real future, second = imaginary present.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
phases.explanation: In second conditional with I/he/she we use were.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write 3 sentences using first conditional about your plans and 3 using second conditional about hypothetical situations.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: If you study hard, you ___ the exam.
phases.explanation: First conditional: if + present, will + verb.
